content.text: For digital creators in Nigeria, Stripe's restrictions are just the beginning of their infrastructure pains. In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Pakistan, conventional payment platforms like PayPal, Gumroad, and Stripe are either unavailable or severely restricted. This forces creators to either abandon their digital product stores or explore workarounds that compromise their business and data sovereignty. The issue isn't just about transaction fees, which can add up quickly. That's why COREMERCH offers a sovereign digital commerce stack that empowers creators to own their infrastructure, their data, and their customers. With a complete suite of free and paid tools, creators can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. It's not a workaround; it's base-layer infrastructure that gives creators the freedom and control they need to succeed.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series.
